title: Florida Lottery – Scratch-to-Reveal Interstitial
summary: A holiday mobile interstitial where users scratch the card on screen to reveal the gift.
description: A Spanish-language holiday interstitial for the Florida Lottery: "Encuentra el regalo perfecto". Users scratch the gift card with a finger (or the mouse) to reveal the prize, turning a full-screen placement into a moment of play. Built in HTML5 and hosted on Collabo's demo server.
